items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: I had a fellow who had been in the service by a name of Gus Allen... They organized a boys band there... So they did, and they put me on the alto horn.

ctx.x: I'm L.D. Harris. My real name is Lawrence Douglas Harris. I was born and raised in Brenham, Texas. That's about 165 miles from here. It's on H and T.C. between Austin and Houston, Texas. And I started out playing music between the ages of 13 and 14, started studying music. They organized a boys band there. I had a fellow who had been in the service by the name of Gus Allen. Everybody called him Uncle Beansy. He's quite a musician. And my father and several other fathers there in the city thought it would be a…
John Johnson. You want to go there one time?
